positions.title: CTO
positions.description: Launching in late 2019, Strety is a people management / performance management platform built for the small to medium sized business.

positions.title: Senior Technical Manager
positions.description:
Participate in the design, development, implementation and maintenance of message oriented middleware for Law Enforcement Information Systems. Including the development of socket interfaces to external systems.

Design and development of a User and Device management web application using Django. The application included role based access levels.

Troubleshooting networking and application issues using standard tools like ngrep.

Support and maintain customer software solutions. Conducting meetings, and designing, developing and implementing solutions to meet their changing needs.

Conducting and participating in peer code reviews.

Linux systems administration tasks.

Designing and implementing RESTful interfaces for authenticating, updating and querying user data stores.
